title: WmsEnvelope
description: Layer 1 — stable WMS message envelope. Owned by the security/infrastructure team. Validates the Header block only. DOC_HEADER is intentionally opaque: format never changes with business requirements; business content never belongs here.

InterfaceName.description: SAP WMS interface routing key. Always begins with 'Z' (custom namespace), uppercase alphanumeric + underscore. Strictly pattern-checked — unknown interfaces are hard-rejected. Analogous to message_type in the generic firewall.

MessageId.description: Unique 16-digit zero-padded message identifier assigned by the sending system.

PlantCode.description: SAP 4-digit numeric plant code. Infrastructure primitive — owned by the infra/master-data team. Declared once here; $ref'd by any payload field that carries a plant code (SUPPLYING_PLANT, RECEIVING_PLANT, TRANSIT_DOCKING_PLANT).

ConsigneeCode.description: Recipient/consignee short code. Uppercase alphanumeric, 2–10 chars. Infrastructure-level recipient identity — not a business-domain customer identifier.

SapDate.description: SAP compact date format YYYYMMDD. Used for all date fields across envelope and payload. Declared once here; $ref'd by payload date fields (DELIVERY_DATE etc.).

SapTime.description: SAP compact time format HHMMSS (24-hour). Used in envelope timestamp; payload systems may $ref for time fields.

OpaqueDocHeader.description: Business document payload. INTENTIONALLY OPAQUE to the firewall. Structure varies by WMS_ORD_TP order type. The recipient/WMS system is the sole owner of DOC_HEADER validation (Layer 2).

Header.description: Message envelope. All 6 fields are infrastructure invariants validated by the firewall.
